title: epiphyllum quezaltecum
intro: Epiphyllum quezaltecum, commonly known as the Night-Blooming Cereus, is a species of cactus that belongs to the Epiphyllum genus, characterized by its white, funnel-shaped flowers that bloom at night and are pollinated by bats. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Epiphyllum quezaltecum include relaxing the nervous system, reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting better sleep. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
